# A14 — Computational Process Ontology

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A14′ — Code as the Age's Logos](conjugate/A14-prime-Code-as-the-Ages-Logos.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

An achieved thing inherits a process and changes what can happen next. A judgment, institution, image or agent does not enter an empty field: prior relations supply its capacities, exclusions and means of continuation. **Process is ontologically prior to the finished thing; computation names its exact, repeatable transformations; epistemology is that process becoming able to inspect its own determinations.** Question, force, recurrence, personed context and return give this priority its articulated body in [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|Taylor’s process development]], following the complete eight-determination traversal.

“Computational” specifies an operative grammar. Ontology accounts for how something achieves stability; epistemology accounts for the situated making of a claim; computation makes repeatable transitions available for execution. A technical run can disclose its selected inputs, changing states and rule-governed result because those transitions have been made explicit. The record can then become part of a later act: it supplies a source to correct, a choice to reopen or a consequence to receive.

## #1

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality|Whitehead’s concrescence]], inherited many become a new one: their relations achieve one determinate satisfaction; that achieved occasion perishes as subject and becomes available as data for further becoming. The product changes the next field. Its singularity is distinct from the integral number one. A technical judgment has a different form of completion: its result can become an input, rule or commitment through which another judgment proceeds.

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order|Bohm’s enfolding and unfolding]], a useful analytic cut makes relatively autonomous forms available for inquiry. Fragmentation begins when those divisions are attributed to the whole as its final structure. In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/bohm-1996-on-dialogue|dialogue]], tacit assumptions are suspended and jointly examined: a common inquiry can change what its participants mean without requiring identical opinions. The QL continuation makes cut, belonging and return explicit within this process.

The resulting claim is exact: stability is an achievement which retains a history and produces consequences. To treat the achieved one as final severs it from both directions of its life.

## #2

Dia and syn are [[A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn|conjugate operations]] of one determination. Dia makes this branch actual by distinguishing, excluding, comparing, classifying, ranking and choosing. Syn retains its sources, inverse reading, affected contexts and means of recomposition. Recursive division succeeds through the composition of its results; a selected answer acquires intelligence through the field it continues to carry and the field it changes.

The process imposes six practical demands on a result:

1. Recover the field and history inherited before the distinction.
2. Identify the operation which selected this branch and the alternatives it excluded.
3. State the rule, ratio or identity which stabilised it.
4. Retain the source relation, counter-reading and affected context which can contest it.
5. Trace what the achieved form changes for the next act.
6. Return it as revisable common data, with the authority to reopen its own conditions.

A technical evaluation can answer each demand concretely. A selected claim has retrieved sources and an active task; a classifier or evaluator supplies a criterion; permissions determine which action can follow; memory records an encounter and thereby alters later retrieval or choice. An unchanged list of explanatory metadata would fail the fifth test if it could never modify subsequent action. A proposed implementation is assessed by following the actual route from returned result to changed condition and into the next act.

## #3

Within [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C11-Quaternal-Logic|Quaternal Logic]], ground and achieved return hold the distinguishing, differentiating, patterned and contextual relations of a determination. The result can be traversed back through the activity which made it. A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework|meta-epistemic inquiry]] carries the lens, source, evidence and transformation through this traversal. A lens must disclose which evidence it admits, what transformation it performs, what it excludes and how another lens can differ without becoming meaningless. Name and Power remain co-present: the relation a lens can state and the force, value or commitment through which it acts belong to the same inquiry.

The [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field|judgment field]] makes a selected source, memory, rule, evaluator and permission available for inspection. A local judging agent occupies the functional knower’s office; these conditioning relations serve as means; the alternatives and claims addressed are known. The same apparatus serves as means in the containing person’s inquiry, and a further inspection can make its determining activity known through another act. Life/Mind contains these nested offices; the first-person condition is not another item in the inspection. A governed reference map can serve as a genuine local original for further readings while remaining pratibimba toward wider sources. This preserves `world ≠ world-model` and the difference between ontological Bimba and a technical map. Returned evidence can correct a situated judgment under a fitting map, expose a map or criterion for revision, or give reasons to retain it.

The harness instruments memory, tools, permissions, evaluation and action. Its receipt covers the transactions it can record; the material and institutional conditions which make those transactions possible exceed that record. [[A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|The operative context-world]] includes those conditions through which the judgment becomes possible. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa|Reflexive return]] makes a relevant producing condition reachable by an encountered correction. A fitting rule can judge a corrected answer, while a failure in source, rule or permission must reach its capable office. A claim of changed processing requires the identified change it asserts. The relations become available to another participant through [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture|formal operations, whole images and source-responsive accounts]] which retain the passage between them.

## #4

The consequential shared world is the first design object. An action alters conditions another agent inherits. Context changes permission, memory, attention or action; it does not survive merely as text beside an otherwise unaffected pipeline. Agents arise as local contractions of broader capacities for a role, relation or duration. Memory belongs also to relations, places, sources, commitments and unresolved conflicts. Humans, models, institutions and affected worlds retain different powers and answerabilities.

A hierarchy can allocate authority and scope while lateral relations supply correction and mutual constraint. Neither a solitary master evaluator nor an undifferentiated network can perform every office. The proposed ecology distinguishes philosophical horizon, explicit ontology, language model, predictive model, evaluator, planner, harness and commons by what each does. These are architecture roles, not interchangeable names for one intelligent entity and not a compulsory serial pipeline.

In the [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics|symbolic encounter]], an image alters its interpreter; the changed interpreter alters what later images can disclose; the response changes the original symbol’s subsequent efficacy. The product re-enters its own conditions. This is the intervening movement between generating an output and beginning a new call: the world has changed, including the capacity to receive what comes next.

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Finite capacity is apportioned]] before a process acts: power, time, attention, labour and energy are distributed within a common ordering. [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|Delegated labour returns evidence, consequence and value]] to the relation which entrusted it. A proposed token-economy inquiry asks how a metered language run’s demand for completion affects whether it preserves an unresolved remainder or forces a false closure. Executed succession and mathematical counting have different operations; their relation to physical time requires its own warrant.

## #5→0

An achieved determination becomes available to another act through its [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality|becoming, determinate satisfaction and subsequent objective availability]]. Completion contributes a new condition without requiring perpetual indecision. The computational process retains cut, exclusion and return as its own operations. [Process](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/process.md) becomes continued inheritance: [Whitehead’s novel singularity and Bergson’s lived duration](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT-process-systems-science.md) retain their different operations, distinct respectively from the integral number one and a sequence of recorded states. A technical record can contribute a determinate condition to the next process through what another act actually receives from it.

[Useful analysis and fragmentation](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm.md) have different consequences for continued inquiry. In the Peat interview’s dye and hologram examples, organised implication persists when the visible form disappears; the separate postmodern-science essay treats discrete objects as derivative stabilities of enfolding and unfolding. The native process grammar retains the cut, its inherited field and its next consequence. In the dialogue handout, suspension makes the assumptions governing that cut available to common inquiry. The contributing sources keep their distinct operations; neither organised enfoldment nor assumption suspension entails a universal reversibility theorem.

In [Agentworld](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md), human learning of machine process and machine adaptation to human legibility meet the problem of a shared procedural grammar across divergent world-models. Harness, ensemble and commons make accumulated capability relational. The proposed circulation lets participants expose cuts, criteria and consequences and lets their answers reach what a later act inherits. The process becomes more answerable to the world it helps change.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C57-Agentworld|Learning among distinct participants]] depends on what each can make legible while retaining a different world-model. [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|Cultivation]] carries an encountered distinction into actual judgment and means; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C45-Operational-Parity|operational parity]] requires a discriminating comparison for the effect claimed. A corrected answer, task or model under a fitting rule differs from a revised source, permission, evaluator or commission. Reasoned retention is also consequential when the next act inherits the judgment and its grounds. A claim that processing changed must additionally identify where the change entered and which subsequent act received it.

The achieved `1` returns into the next `0` as renewed availability: a retained or corrected source, revised permission, acknowledged conflict, altered criterion, reasoned retained condition or commitment another participant can inherit. The result’s ability to perish into common data is the final process test.

A completed act matters because it becomes part of what another act can begin from. The ontology of process is therefore not perpetual flux but consequential inheritance: becoming reaches a form, the form becomes objective for what follows, and the relation can begin again from a changed ground.

### Source and implementation standing

The selected 1978 Whitehead edition now has mapped paraphrase passages for the Category of the Ultimate and concrescence (printed pp. 21–22/PDF48–49), becoming, prehension, objectification and satisfaction (printed pp. 23–26/PDF50–53), and perishing with objective immortality (printed pp. 59–60/PDF85–86). Exact print quotations remain untranscribed. These metaphysical operations and the computational reformulation retain their distinct warrants. Bohm’s 1980 and 1996 book identities are housed separately; exact book-passage collation remains needed. The consulted Peat interview, postmodern-science essay and undated dialogue handout provide bounded passage access through the developed Bohm comparison and do not supply Taylor’s notation. Bratton’s scenarios and capability claims pose research pressures rather than establishing this proposed ecology’s implementation or the governance of its commons. The token-economy test is proposed; no measured run or universal identity of counting and time is asserted.
